title: Free fibrations, lax colimits and Kan extensions for $(\infty,2)$-categories
summary: In the first part of this paper we study fibrations of $(\infty,2)$-categories. We give a simple characterization of such fibrations in terms of a certain square being a pullback, and apply this to show that in some cases $(\infty,2)$-categories of functors and partially (op)lax transformations preserve fibrations.
